358:     /// <summary>Returns true on success.</summary>
359:     private async Task<bool> StartDownloadAsync(string id, string title, bool showFolderWarning = true)
360:     {
361:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_settings.ModsFolder))
362:         {
363:             if (showFolderWarning) MessageBox.Show("Choose a destination folder first.");
364:             return false;
365:         }
366: 
367:         var task = new DownloadTask
368:         {
369:             Id = id,
370:             Title = title,
371:             Status = "Downloading",
372:             StartedAt = DateTime.Now.ToString("h:mm:ss tt"),
373:         };
374:         _downloads.Insert(0, task);
375:         SaveDownloadHistory();
376: 
377:         // Batch 4: fetch this mod's preview thumbnail in the background so the
378:         // Downloads tab shows it even before a full history reload.
379:         _ = FetchTaskThumbnailAsync(task);
380: 
381:         StatusText.Text = $"Downloading {title}...";
382:         AppendLog($"Starting download: {title} ({id})");
383:         ProgressBarCtl.IsIndeterminate = true;
384:         try
385:         {
386:             var installedPaths = await SteamCmdService.DownloadModAsync(id, _settings.ModsFolder, line =>
387:             {
388:                 // SteamCMD's output arrives on a background thread.
389:                 Dispatcher.Invoke(() => task.Detail = line);
390:                 AppendLog(line, "DEBUG");
391:             });
392: 
393:             // Record the content manifest id (not a date) as the "version"
394:             // we now have locally, so future update-checks compare like for like.
395:             try
396:             {
397:                 var details = await WorkshopApiService.GetDetailsAsync(id);
398:                 _settings.LocalModVersions[id] = details.ContentManifestId;
399:                 _settings.InstallDates[id] = DateTimeOffset.Now.ToString("dd-MMM-yy h:mm:ss tt");
400:             }
401:             catch
402:             {
403:                 // Offline right after downloading -- leave whatever version
404:                 // was previously recorded (or none) rather than fail the download.
405:             }
406:             SettingsService.Save(_settings);
407: 
408:             task.Status = "Done";
409:             task.FinishedAt = DateTime.Now.ToString("h:mm:ss tt");
410:             task.Detail = installedPaths.Count == 1
411:                 ? $"Installed to \"{Path.GetFileName(installedPaths[0])}\""
412:                 : $"{installedPaths.Count} mod folders installed";
413: 
414:             StatusText.Text = installedPaths.Count == 1
415:                 ? $"Done: {title}"
416:                 : $"Done: {title} ({installedPaths.Count} mod folders installed)";
417:             AppendLog($"Finished: {title} \u2714 ({installedPaths.Count} folder(s))");
418:             SaveDownloadHistory();
419:             await RefreshDownloadedModsAsync();
420:             return true;
421:         }
422:         catch (Exception ex)
423:         {
424:             task.Status = "Failed";
425:             task.FinishedAt = DateTime.Now.ToString("h:mm:ss tt");
426:             task.Detail = ex.Message;
427:             StatusText.Text = $"Failed: {title} — {ex.Message}";
428:             AppendLog($"FAILED: {title} — {ex.Message}", "ERROR");
429:             SaveDownloadHistory();
430:             return false;
431:         }
432:         finally
433:         {
434:             ProgressBarCtl.IsIndeterminate = false;
435:         }
436:     }

474:     /// <summary>
475:     /// Figures out which Steam Workshop id a local mod folder corresponds to.
476:     /// Tries the "<id> <name>" naming convention this app installs mods
477:     /// under first, then falls back to scanning any mod.info file inside for
478:     /// a purely-numeric id= line (some mods happen to use one).
479:     /// </summary>
480:     private static bool TryExtractWorkshopId(string folderPath, out string id)
481:     {
482:         id = "";
483:         var name = Path.GetFileName(folderPath);
484:         if (name.StartsWith("_")) return false; // skip internal folders like _backups
485: 
486:         var m = Regex.Match(name, @"^(\d+)");
487:         if (m.Success)
488:         {
489:             id = m.Groups[1].Value;
490:             return true;
491:         }
492: 
493:         try
494:         {
495:             foreach (var infoFile in Directory.EnumerateFiles(folderPath, "mod.info", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
496:             {
497:                 foreach (var line in File.ReadAllLines(infoFile))
498:                 {
499:                     var lm = Regex.Match(line.Trim(), @"^id\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
500:                     if (lm.Success)
501:                     {
502:                         id = lm.Groups[1].Value;
503:                         return true;
504:                     }
505:                 }
506:             }
507:         }
508:         catch
509:         {
510:             // Unreadable folder -- treat as unresolvable.
511:         }
512: 
513:         return false;
514:     }
515: 
516:     /// <summary>
517:     /// Normalizes a mod identifier for dependency matching: lowercase, remove
518:     /// spaces and punctuation, so "NeatUI_Framework" == "neatui framework" ==
519:     /// "NeatUI Framework" when comparing require= values against installed
520:     /// mods' id=/name= fields.
521:     /// </summary>
522:     private static string NormalizeModIdentifier(string value)
523:     {
524:         var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(value.Length);
525:         foreach (var c in value)
526:         {
527:             if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)) sb.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(c));
528:         }
529:         return sb.ToString();
530:     }

615:     /// <summary>
616:     /// Scans the mods folder, pulls live details from Steam for each mod,
617:     /// and determines which ones need an update -- this single pass now
618:     /// covers both "list what's installed" and "check for updates" (the
619:     /// tabs used to be separate; merged so there's one source of truth).
620:     /// </summary>
621:     private async Task RefreshDownloadedModsAsync()
622:     {
623:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_settings.ModsFolder) || !Directory.Exists(_settings.ModsFolder))
624:             return;
625: 
626:         AppendLog("Refreshing mod list and checking for updates...");
627:         var records = new List<ModRecord>();
628:         int updatesAvailable = 0;
629: 
630:         // Build an index of every installed mod's declared identifiers (id=/name=
631:         // from its mod.info) -> real workshop id (the numeric folder prefix), plus
632:         // the set of installed workshop ids. This lets require= entries (numeric
633:         // ids or internal names like "\NeatUI_Framework") be resolved purely
634:         // against what is already on disk -- no extra Steam API calls.
635:         var installedWorkshopIds = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
636:         var identifierIndex = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
637:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(_settings.ModsFolder))
638:         {
639:             if (!TryExtractWorkshopId(dir, out var knownId)) continue;
640:             installedWorkshopIds.Add(knownId);
641:             foreach (var ident in SteamCmdService.GetModIdentifiers(dir))
642:             {
643:                 var key = NormalizeModIdentifier(ident);
644:                 if (key.Length > 0) identifierIndex.TryAdd(key, knownId);
645:             }
646:         }
647: 
648:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(_settings.ModsFolder))
649:         {
650:             if (!TryExtractWorkshopId(dir, out var id)) continue;
651:             var folderName = Path.GetFileName(dir);
652: 
653:             // Resolve require= entries against the installed-mod index above.
654:             var requires = SteamCmdService.GetRequiresFields(dir);
655:             var missingDeps = new List<string>();
656:             foreach (var req in requires)
657:             {
658:                 bool met = long.TryParse(req, out _)
659:                     ? installedWorkshopIds.Contains(req)
660:                     : identifierIndex.TryGetValue(NormalizeModIdentifier(req), out _);
661:                 if (!met) missingDeps.Add(req);
662:             }
663: 
664:             string title = folderName, posted = "", updated = "", steamVer = "Unknown", creator = "";
665:             bool resolvedRemote = false;
666:             try
667:             {
668:                 var details = await WorkshopApiService.GetDetailsAsync(id);
669:                 title = details.Title;
670:                 posted = details.TimeCreated == default ? "" : details.TimeCreated.ToLocalTime().ToString("dd-MMM-yy h:mm:ss tt");
671:                 updated = details.TimeUpdated == default ? "" : details.TimeUpdated.ToLocalTime().ToString("dd-MMM-yy h:mm:ss tt");
672:                 steamVer = string.IsNullOrEmpty(details.ContentManifestId) ? "Unknown" : details.ContentManifestId;
673:                 resolvedRemote = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(details.ContentManifestId);
674:                 creator = details.Creator;
675:             }
676:             catch
677:             {
678:                 // Offline, or the item was removed -- still show the folder by id.
679:             }
680: 
681:             var hasLocalVersion = _settings.LocalModVersions.TryGetValue(id, out var lv) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(lv);
682:             var localVer = hasLocalVersion ? lv! : "Unknown";
683:             var installDate = _settings.InstallDates.TryGetValue(id, out var idate) ? idate : "";
684: 
685:             bool needsUpdate;
686:             if (!resolvedRemote)
687:                 needsUpdate = false; // couldn't reach Steam -- don't false-flag
688:             else if (!hasLocalVersion)
689:                 needsUpdate = true; // never tracked (e.g. placed manually) -- flag so the user can decide
690:             else
691:                 needsUpdate = !string.Equals(lv, steamVer, StringComparison.Ordinal);
692: 
693:             if (needsUpdate) updatesAvailable++;
694: 
695:             records.Add(new ModRecord
696:             {
697:                 Folder = folderName,
698:                 FullPath = dir,
699:                 Id = id,
700:                 ModName = title,
701:                 Size = FormatSize(GetDirectorySize(dir)),
702:                 Posted = posted,
703:                 Updated = updated,
704:                 LocalVersion = localVer,
705:                 SteamVersion = steamVer,
706:                 InstallDate = installDate,
707:                 NeedsUpdate = needsUpdate,
708:                 StatusLabel = needsUpdate ? "Update Available" : "Updated",
709:                 Creator = creator,
710:                 Dependencies = requires,
711:                 MissingDependencies = missingDeps,
712:                 MissingDepsCount = missingDeps.Count,
713:             });
714:         }
715: 
716:         _downloadedMods.Clear();
717:         foreach (var r in records) _downloadedMods.Add(r);
718: 
719:         UpdatesAvailableText.Text = $"Mods with updates available: {updatesAvailable}";
720:         UpdateAllButton.IsEnabled = updatesAvailable > 0;
721:         AppendLog($"Refresh complete: {records.Count} mod(s) installed, {updatesAvailable} update(s) available.");
722: 
723:         // Batch 4: kick off the preview/tag/thumbnail fetch for installed mods
724:         // in the background. Tag sidebar + thumbnails fill in as it completes.
725:         _ = LoadInstalledVisualsAsync();
726:     }

1021:     /// <summary>
1022:     /// Deletes the folder currently on disk for a mod before an update
1023:     /// redownloads it. This matters because SteamCMD's fresh download can
1024:     /// name the mod's folder slightly differently than what's already
1025:     /// installed (renamed subfolder, capitalization change, etc.) -- the
1026:     /// installer only overwrites a folder when the name matches exactly,
1027:     /// so without this step a mismatch leaves the old copy behind and
1028:     /// creates a duplicate instead of replacing it.
1029:     /// </summary>
1030:     private void RemoveOldModFolder(string folderName)
1031:     {
1032:         try
1033:         {
1034:             var path = Path.Combine(_settings.ModsFolder, folderName);
1035:             if (Directory.Exists(path)) Directory.Delete(path, recursive: true);
1036:         }
1037:         catch (Exception ex)
1038:         {
1039:             // Best-effort -- if this fails, the download will still overwrite
1040:             // any folder whose name happens to match exactly.
1041:             AppendLog($"Could not remove old folder \"{folderName}\" before redownload: {ex.Message}", "WARNING");
1042:         }
1043:     }
1044: 
1045:     private void BackupMod(string folderName)
1046:     {
1047:         try
1048:         {
1049:             var src = Path.Combine(_settings.ModsFolder, folderName);
1050:             if (!Directory.Exists(src)) return;
1051:             var backupDir = Path.Combine(_settings.ModsFolder, "_backups", folderName, DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"));
1052:             Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(backupDir)!);
1053:             CopyDirectory(src, backupDir);
1054:         }
1055:         catch
1056:         {
1057:             // Best-effort backup; don't block the update if it fails.
1058:         }
1059:     }
1060: 
1061:     private static void CopyDirectory(string sourceDir, string destDir)
1062:     {
1063:         Directory.CreateDirectory(destDir);
1064:         foreach (var file in Directory.GetFiles(sourceDir))
1065:             File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(destDir, Path.GetFileName(file)), overwrite: true);
1066:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(sourceDir))
1067:             CopyDirectory(dir, Path.Combine(destDir, Path.GetFileName(dir)));
1068:     }

1106:     /// whether or not it's installed. So the popup is populated from that page
1107:     /// and each entry is annotated installed/missing by comparing its workshop id
1108:     /// against the installed-mod index.
1109:     ///
1110:     /// This lookup happens ONLY here, on explicit user action -- never during
1111:     /// startup or the Installed Mods refresh -- and fetches ONLY this mod's page
1112:     /// (no recursive dependency-page requests). Results are cached per session
1113:     /// and concurrent duplicate clicks are ignored.
1114:     /// </summary>
1115:     private async void ShowDeps_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
1116:     {
1117:         if (sender is not FrameworkElement fe || fe.Tag is not ModRecord mod) return;
1118: 
1119:         // Authoritative installed-workshop-id set for the installed/missing flag.
1120:         var installedIds = _downloadedMods.Select(m => m.Id).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
1121: 
1122:         // Fetch ONLY this mod's page. Per-session cache avoids re-downloading;
1123:         // the in-flight guard drops duplicate clicks while a fetch is running.

221:     {

224:         {

226:             if (!File.Exists(infoPath)) return requires;

229:             {
230:                 var m = Regex.Match(line.Trim(), @"^require\s*=\s*(.+)$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);

232: 
233:                 var value = m.Groups[1].Value.Trim();

236:                 foreach (var part in value.Split(new[] { ',', ';' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))

239:                     if (id.StartsWith("\\")) id = id[1..].Trim();
240:                     if (id.Length > 0) requires.Add(id);

29: 
30:     private const int MaxPerRequest = 100;
31: 
32:     private static readonly HttpClient Http = new();
33: 
34:     /// <summary>
35:     /// Fetches preview_url + tags for the given workshop ids in as few API
36:     /// calls as possible. Never throws for an individual item; a hard network
37:     /// failure throws and is caught by the caller.
38:     /// </summary>
39:     public static async Task<Dictionary<string, WorkshopVisual>> GetVisualsAsync(IEnumerable<string> ids)
40:     {
41:         var idList = ids.Where(id => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)).Distinct().ToList();
42:         var result = new Dictionary<string, WorkshopVisual>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
43: 
44:         foreach (var chunk in Chunks(idList, MaxPerRequest))
45:         {
46:             var content = new Dictionary<string, string> { ["itemcount"] = chunk.Count.ToString() };
47:             for (int i = 0; i < chunk.Count; i++)
48:                 content[$"publishedfileids[{i}]"] = chunk[i];
49: 
50:             var resp = await Http.PostAsync(Endpoint, new FormUrlEncodedContent(content));
51:             resp.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
52: 
53:             using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
54:             var list = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("response").GetProperty("publishedfiledetails");
55: 
56:             foreach (var el in list.EnumerateArray())
57:             {
58:                 var id = GetString(el, "publishedfileid");
59:                 if (id == null) continue;
60: 
61:                 var visual = new WorkshopVisual
62:                 {
63:                     Id = id,
64:                     PreviewUrl = GetString(el, "preview_url") ?? "",
65:                 };

69:                         if (t.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && t.TryGetProperty("tag", out var tag))

1: using System;
2: using System.IO;
3: using System.Net.Http;
4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
5: 
6: namespace PZWorkshopDownloader.Services;
7: 
8: /// <summary>
9: /// Local thumbnail cache. Thumbnails are stored as "<workshopId>.jpg"
10: /// under %LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\thumbnails\ and are reused across
11: /// runs, so only genuinely missing images get re-downloaded.
12: /// </summary>
13: public static class ThumbnailStore
14: {
15:     private static readonly HttpClient Http = new();
16: 
17:     public static string CacheDir => Path.Combine(
18:         Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData),
19:         "PZWorkshopDownloader", "thumbnails");
20: 
21:     /// <summary>Path to the cached thumbnail for a workshop id, or "" if not cached.</summary>
22:     public static string GetCachedPath(string workshopId)
23:     {
24:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(workshopId)) return "";
25:         var path = Path.Combine(CacheDir, workshopId + ".jpg");
26:         return File.Exists(path) ? path : "";
27:     }
28: 
29:     /// <summary>
30:     /// Downloads a thumbnail into the cache. Returns the local path on success,
31:     /// or "" if the download failed (callers then fall back to a placeholder).
32:     /// Never throws.
33:     /// </summary>
34:     public static async Task<string> DownloadAsync(string workshopId, string previewUrl)
35:     {
36:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(workshopId) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(previewUrl)) return "";
37:         try
38:         {
39:             Directory.CreateDirectory(CacheDir);
40:             var bytes = await Http.GetByteArrayAsync(previewUrl);
41:             if (bytes.Length == 0) return "";
42:             var path = Path.Combine(CacheDir, workshopId + ".jpg");
43:             await File.WriteAllBytesAsync(path, bytes);
44:             return path;
45:         }
46:         catch
47:         {
48:             return "";
49:         }
50:     }
51: 
52:     /// <summary>Cache path if already present, otherwise downloads and returns it (or "" on failure).</summary>
53:     public static async Task<string> GetOrDownloadAsync(string workshopId, string previewUrl)
54:     {
55:         var cached = GetCachedPath(workshopId);
56:         if (cached.Length > 0) return cached;
57:         return await DownloadAsync(workshopId, previewUrl);
58:     }
59: }

<Window x:Class="PZWorkshopDownloader.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:wv2="clr-namespace:Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Wpf;assembly=Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Wpf"
        Title="Project Zomboid Workshop Downloader"
        Height="880" Width="1300" MinHeight="600" MinWidth="900"
        FontSize="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeGeneral}"
        Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">

    <Window.Resources>

        <!-- Batch 4: shared tile thumbnail block (initial-letter placeholder until
             ThumbnailPath arrives; the image then covers it). Width/Height follow
             the app-wide ModTileSize resource so the slider resizes every tile. -->
        <DataTemplate x:Key="TileThumbnail">
            <Grid Width="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}" Height="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}">
                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="6"
                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="26" FontWeight="Bold"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </Border>
                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="2.5">
                    <Image.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </Image.Style>
                </Image>
            </Grid>
        </DataTemplate>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="DownloadsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Remove From List" Click="RemoveDownloadEntry_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="InstalledModsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Folder" Click="OpenFolder_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.FullPath, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Page" Click="ModPage_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.Id, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Update This Mod" Click="UpdateSingleMod_Click"
                      IsEnabled="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.NeedsUpdate, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Force Redownload" Click="ForceRedownloadMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Show Dependencies" Click="ShowDeps_Click"
                      IsEnabled="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.HasDependencies, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Uninstall" Click="UninstallMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="UninstalledModsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Reinstall" Click="ReinstallMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Page" Click="ModPage_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.Id, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Forget" Click="ForgetUninstalledMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <!-- ============ Tile mode (Batch 4) ============
             Shared styles so all three tile grids stay consistent.
             NOTE: we pulse via Opacity (DoubleAnimation), never by animating a
             brush Color. WPF freezes SolidColorBrush instances inside shared
             DataTemplates, so ColorAnimation on (Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)
             throws "Cannot animate on an immutable object instance". -->

        <!-- Common chrome for every tile button. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,10,10"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="6"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- Mod name text (Installed tiles turn orange+bold when an update is out). -->
        <Style x:Key="TileNameTextStyle" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="MaxHeight" Value="34"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,4,0,2"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeGeneral}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Status line shared appearance. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileStatusTextBase" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="11"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#3EB489"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- Update status: solid green, orange + opacity pulse when NeedsUpdate. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileUpdateStatusText" TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="TileUpdatePulse">
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                 Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="TileUpdatePulse"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Requirement status: solid green, orange + opacity pulse when HasMissingDeps. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileRequirementStatusText" TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasMissingDeps}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="TileRequirementPulse">

                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="TileRequirementPulse"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

    </Window.Resources>

    <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">

        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

        <TabControl x:Name="MainTabs" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"
                    BorderThickness="0" Margin="0">

            <!-- ============ SETTINGS TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Settings">
                <StackPanel Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}" Margin="16">

                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>

                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,24">

                    <TextBlock Text="Options" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>

                              Checked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Unchecked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>

                              Checked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Unchecked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>

                              Checked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Unchecked="SettingsCheckbox_Changed" Margin="0,0,0,20"/>

                    <TextBlock Text="Theme" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                    <ComboBox x:Name="ThemeCombo" Width="220" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                              SelectionChanged="ThemeCombo_SelectionChanged">
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Light"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Dark"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Midnight"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Forest"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Nord"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Dracula"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Solarized Dark"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Solarized Light"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Gruvbox"/>
                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Monokai"/>

                    <TextBlock Text="UI Customization" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,24,0,10"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Font sizes apply live. Scroll speed multiplies the mouse-wheel step of the tables and lists."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>

                        <Slider x:Name="FontGeneralSlider" Width="220" Minimum="10" Maximum="20" TickFrequency="0.5"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" ValueChanged="UiFontSlider_Changed"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontGeneralLabel" Text="12.5" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">

                        <Slider x:Name="FontButtonsSlider" Width="220" Minimum="10" Maximum="20" TickFrequency="0.5"

                        <TextBlock x:Name="FontButtonsLabel" Text="12.5" Width="50" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>

                            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>

                            <Button Content="Clear Log" Click="ClearLogButton_Click" Padding="8,3"/>
                        </StackPanel>

                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding DisplayText}" TextWrapping="Wrap">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Level}" Value="DEBUG">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#8A97A3"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Level}" Value="WARNING">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFA500"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding Level}" Value="ERROR">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF6B6B"/>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                            </ListBox>
                            <Button x:Name="JumpToBottomButton" Content="Jump to Bottom ▼" Click="JumpToBottomButton_Click"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Margin="0,0,0,10"
                                    Visibility="Collapsed" Background="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" Foreground="Black" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        </Grid>
                    </Grid>
                </Border>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>
    </Grid>
</Window>

<!-- ============ BROWSER TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Browser" x:Name="BrowserTabItem">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <!-- Address bar -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="8,8,8,4">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button Grid.Column="0" Content="◀" Click="Back_Click" ToolTip="Back"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="▶" Click="Forward_Click" ToolTip="Forward"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="⌂" Click="Home_Click" ToolTip="Workshop Home"/>
                        <TextBox x:Name="AddressBar" Grid.Column="3" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                                 VerticalContentAlignment="Center" KeyDown="AddressBar_KeyDown"/>
                    </Grid>

                    <!-- Action buttons -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,0,8,6">
                        <TextBlock Text="Folder:" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="3"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="DestFolderLabel" Text="Not set" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0" MaxWidth="260"
                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                        <Button Content="Download This Mod/Collection" Click="DownloadCurrent_Click" Margin="20,3,3,3"
                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        <Button Content="Add To Queue" Click="AddToQueue_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- Browser -->
                    <wv2:WebView2 x:Name="Browser" Grid.Row="2"
                                  Source="https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=108600&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems"/>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ============ DOWNLOADS TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Downloads">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,8,8,0">
                        <Button Content="Clear Finished" Click="ClearFinishedDownloads_Click"/>
                        <Button Content="Clear All" Click="ClearAllDownloads_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- View toggle + tile size -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="DownloadsListToggle" Content="☰ List" Tag="List"
                                      IsChecked="True" Checked="DownloadsView_Checked" Padding="8,3"/>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="DownloadsTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"
                                      Checked="DownloadsView_Checked" Padding="8,3" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="Tile size:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,4,0"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                        <Slider Width="140" Minimum="80" Maximum="260" Value="140"
                                ValueChanged="ModTileSize_Changed" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <Grid Grid.Row="2" Margin="8,0,8,8">
                        <DataGrid x:Name="DownloadsGrid">
                            <DataGrid.RowStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                                    <Setter Property="Tag" Value="{Binding}"/>
                                    <Setter Property="ContextMenu" Value="{StaticResource DownloadsRowContextMenu}"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1EFFFFFF"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </DataGrid.RowStyle>
                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="42">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Grid Width="32" Height="32">
                                                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="4"
                                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                </Border>
                                                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="1.5">
                                                    <Image.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                </DataTrigger>
                                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </Image.Style>
                                                </Image>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Status" Binding="{Binding Status}" Width="100"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Mod" Binding="{Binding Title}" Width="*"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Detail" Binding="{Binding Detail}" Width="280"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Started" Binding="{Binding StartedAt}" Width="100"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Finished" Binding="{Binding FinishedAt}" Width="100"/>
                            </DataGrid.Columns>
                        </DataGrid>

                        <ScrollViewer Visibility="{Binding Visibility, ElementName=DownloadsTiles}" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                            <ItemsControl x:Name="DownloadsTiles" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,2,0,0">
                                <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                    <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                        <WrapPanel/>
                                    </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Click="ModPage_Click" Tag="{Binding}"
                                                Style="{StaticResource TileButtonStyle}"
                                                ContextMenu="{StaticResource DownloadsRowContextMenu}"
                                                ToolTip="{Binding Title}">
                                            <StackPanel>
                                                <ContentControl Content="{Binding}" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource TileThumbnail}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" Style="{StaticResource TileNameTextStyle}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Status}" Style="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </Button>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ============ INSTALLED MODS TAB (also handles update checking) ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Installed Mods" x:Name="InstalledModsTabItem">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="8,8,8,0">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button Grid.Column="0" Content="Refresh Mod List" Click="RefreshDownloadedMods_Click"/>
                        <Button x:Name="UpdateAllButton" Grid.Column="1" Content="Update All" Click="UpdateAllButton_Click"
                                IsEnabled="False" Margin="10,3,3,3"
                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="Export List..." Click="ExportModList_Click" Margin="10,3,3,3"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="3" Content="Import List..." Click="ImportModList_Click"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="UpdatesAvailableText" Grid.Column="4"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                   Text="Mods with updates available: 0"/>
                    </Grid>

                    <!-- View toggle + tile size + tag sidebar collapse -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="InstalledListToggle" Content="☰ List" Tag="List"
                                      IsChecked="True" Checked="InstalledView_Checked" Padding="8,3"/>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="InstalledTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"
                                      Checked="InstalledView_Checked" Padding="8,3" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="Tile size:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,4,0"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                        <Slider Width="140" Minimum="80" Maximum="260" Value="140"
                                ValueChanged="ModTileSize_Changed" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                        <Button x:Name="TagSidebarToggle" Content="◀" Click="ToggleTagSidebar_Click"
                                Padding="8,3" Margin="14,0,0,0" ToolTip="Toggle tag filter sidebar"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- Content: tag filter sidebar + list/tiles -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="2" Margin="8,0,8,8">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition x:Name="TagSidebarColumn" Width="190"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                        <!-- Tag filter sidebar -->
                        <Border Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,8,0" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"
                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4"
                                Padding="8">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="Filter by tag"
                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                                <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                                    <Button Content="Select All" Click="SelectAllTags_Click" Padding="6,2" FontSize="11"/>
                                    <Button Content="Clear" Click="ClearTags_Click" Padding="6,2" FontSize="11" Margin="6,0,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TagCountText" DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="0 tag(s)"
                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" FontSize="11" Margin="0,0,0,4"/>
                                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                                    <StackPanel x:Name="TagFilterPanel"/>
                                </ScrollViewer>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>

                        <DataGrid x:Name="DownloadedModsGrid" Grid.Column="1">
                            <DataGrid.RowStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                                    <Setter Property="Tag" Value="{Binding}"/>
                                    <Setter Property="ContextMenu" Value="{StaticResource InstalledModsRowContextMenu}"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1EFFFFFF"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </DataGrid.RowStyle>
                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="42" SortMemberPath="ModName">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Grid Width="32" Height="32">
                                                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="4"
                                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                </Border>
                                                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="1.5">
                                                    <Image.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                </DataTrigger>
                                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </Image.Style>
                                                </Image>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Folder" Binding="{Binding Folder}" Width="2*"/>
                            <DataGridTextColumn Header="Mod Name" Binding="{Binding ModName}" Width="3*"/>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Status" Width="1.6*" SortMemberPath="StatusLabel">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding StatusLabel}" FontWeight="Bold" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>
                                                <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#3EB489"/>
                                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                                        <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                                                            <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                                <BeginStoryboard x:Name="PulseStoryboard">
                                                                    <Storyboard>
                                                                        <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                                                         From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                                                         Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                                                                    </Storyboard>
                                                                </BeginStoryboard>
                                                            </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                                                            <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                                <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="PulseStoryboard"/>
                                                            </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                                                        </DataTrigger>
                                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                                </Style>
                                            </TextBlock.Style>
                                        </TextBlock>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                            </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                            <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Requirements" Width="1.6*" SortMemberPath="RequirementLabel">
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding RequirementLabel}" FontWeight="Bold" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <TextBlock.Style>

Browser tab — WebView2 embedded browser for the Steam Workshop; address bar w/ search auto-completion, back/forward/home; "Download This Mod/Collection", "Add To Queue"; parsing current workshop id from URL. 2. Downloads tab — download task history grid + tile view; status, detail (last SteamCMD output line), started/finished times; Clear Finished / Clear All; row context menu Remove. 3. Installed Mods tab — list/tile view of installed mods; refresh scans folder + pulls Steam details + update checking; tag filter sidebar; Export/Import mod lists; Update All / per-row buttons (open folder, open page, update, force redownload, uninstall, show deps); status pulse animations. 4. Uninstalled Mods tab — mods previously uninstalled; reinstall/forget/open page. 5. Settings tab — mods folder picker, options (backup, auto-refresh, debug logging), 10 themes, font sizes. ## Features in detail ### Download pipeline (SteamCmdService) - Self-bootstraps SteamCMD: if steamcmd.exe missing, downloads zip from Valve's akamai CDN, extracts into %LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\steamcmd\. - Bootstrap: runs `+quit` once to trigger self-update so it doesn't interleave with real downloads. - DownloadModAsync: `+force_install_dir +login anonymous +workshop_download_item 108600 +quit`. Serialized via a global SemaphoreSlim(1,1) since SteamCMD doesn't handle concurrent instances. - Parses output lines → log / task Detail via dispatcher. - After download, inspects the Steam cache content at steamapps/workshop/content/108600//. If there's a `mods` subfolder, copies each mod folder into dest/ using mod.info name (sanitized) when available; else installs raw content as dest/. Deletes any existing dest folder first to avoid duplicates. - Records the Steam `hcontent_file` (ContentManifestId) as "version" + install date into settings. - Handles SteamCMD's benign nonzero exit codes (self-update relaunch) when files exist. ### Update checking (RefreshDownloadedModsAsync) - Scans every subfolder in mods folder. TryExtractWorkshopId: reads numeric prefix from folder name (this app's own convention) or finds a mod.info with a purely-numeric id= line. Skips `_`-prefixed folders (_backups). - For each folder, calls WorkshopApiService.GetDetailsAsync to get title, dates, ContentManifestId, creator. If unreachable, doesn't false-flag updates. - NeedsUpdate: no local version recorded (e.g. manually placed) → true; else compare local recorded manifest id to live Steam one. - Also computes missing dependencies purely locally (zero extra API calls): builds identifier→workshopId index from installed mods' id=/name= fields normalized via NormalizeModIdentifier; checks each require= entry (numeric → installed id set; name → identifier index). ### Dependencies (Show Deps / Batch 3) - Primary source: parses the mod's Steam Workshop page HTML for the "Required items" section (WorkshopPageService), regex extracting `
Title
`. Browser UA header. This maps name-only require= entries to real numeric workshop ids. Cached per session; in-flight guard prevents duplicate fetches. - Fallback: mod.info require= resolution against installed mods. - DepsDialog lists each dependency with installed/missing flag; Queue / Open Page / Add All buttons. Missing numeric deps can be queued; name-only missing deps open a Steam search in the embedded browser. ### Uninstall / reinstall - Uninstall deletes folder, records entry in uninstalled_mods.json (id, name, author, date). - Reinstall re-downloads fresh from Workshop and removes the entry. Forget removes from list. ### Download history - download_history.json, capped at 300 entries, newest first. Each attempt is a row; persists across runs. ### Batch 4 visual subsystem - WorkshopVisualService: batches up to 100 ids per GetPublishedFileDetails call, extracts preview_url + tags. - ThumbnailStore: caches as .jpg under thumbnails\, reused across runs. - ThumbnailGate SemaphoreSlim(4) throttles concurrent image downloads. - ModRecord/DownloadTask/UninstalledModEntry implement INPC on ThumbnailPath so grid/tile cells update in place. - Tile view mode with ModTileSize app resource, WrapPanel; shared TileThumbnail template showing Initial placeholder until image arrives. - Tag filter sidebar: rebuilds from union of tags; CollectionViewSource filter on the shared collection so grid+tiles both filter. Mods with no tags stay visible. - Pulsing status animations via DataTrigger + BeginStoryboard DoubleAnimation on Opacity (green→orange pulse). Note in comments: can't animate brush Color because WPF freezes brushes in shared DataTemplates. ### Log panel - AppendLog: timestamped entries, dispatcher-safe, cap 500, auto-scrolls only when at bottom; else Jump to Bottom button. DEBUG lines suppressed unless debug logging enabled. Level-colored rows. ### Theming - 10 themes via 7 DynamicResource brushes; SetBrush replaces the resource (frozen brush workaround). Live-switched. - Font sizes as app-level sys:Double resources updated live by sliders. ### App.xaml.cs exception handling - DispatcherUnhandledException (non-fatal, keep app alive), AppDomain unhandled (fatal background), TaskScheduler unobserved. ## Project Zomboid Workshop Downloader — Code Analysis A .NET 8 WPF desktop app (single project, one NuGet dep: WebView2) that lets you browse the Steam Workshop, download Project Zomboid mods via **SteamCMD**, install them into a local mods folder, manage updates/uninstalls, and resolve dependencies. Everything centers on `MainWindow.xaml(.cs)` (~1470 lines of code + ~890 of XAML); services and models are thin support layers. --- ### Application flow (high-level) 1. User browses the Workshop in an embedded WebView2 browser, finds a mod, and either downloads it directly or adds it to a side-panel queue. 2. A download launches headless SteamCMD (`+workshop_download_item 108600 `), which pulls the raw mod from Steam. 3. The app post-processes Steam's cache layout into Project Zomboid's expected local layout (` ` folders). 4. The Installed Mods tab scans that folder, queries Steam for live metadata, and flags which mods need updates and which dependencies are missing. 5. Version tracking uses Steam's `hcontent_file` manifest id (not dates) so update detection matches actual content changes. --- ### Main tabs (`MainWindow.xaml`) - **Browser** — `WebView2` embedded browser pointed at the PZ Workshop browse page (AppId `108600`). Back/Forward/Home, an address bar that treats non-URL input as a Workshop search, "Download This Mod/Collection" and "Add To Queue" buttons. The current mod id is parsed from the browser URL (`[?&]id=(\d+)`); the title comes from the page's document title after `::`. - **Downloads** — list grid + tile view of every download attempt (persisted history, newest first, capped at 300). Columns: status, mod title, detail (last SteamCMD output line or a summary), started/finished times. Clear Finished / Clear All, per-row remove. - **Installed Mods** — the heart of the app: "Refresh Mod List" (scan + metadata + update check), "Update All", XML Export/Import, a tag-filter sidebar, per-row buttons (open folder, open page, update-when-available, force redownload, uninstall, show deps), plus list/tile view toggle. - **Uninstalled Mods** — records of previously uninstalled mods with Reinstall / Forget / Open Page actions. - **Settings** — mods folder picker, three toggles (backup-before-update, auto-refresh on tab switch, debug logging), theme selector (10 palettes), and four live font-size sliders. Two window-level panels overlay every tab: the auto-showing **queue side panel** and the collapsible **bottom log/status panel**. --- ### Key services **`SteamCmdService.cs`** — the download engine. - Self-bootstraps SteamCMD on first run: downloads `steamcmd.zip` (~5MB) from Valve's Akamai CDN, extracts to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\steamcmd\`, then runs `+quit` once to absorb SteamCMD's own self-update (which can relaunch the process and return a nonzero exit code that would otherwise confuse things). - `DownloadModAsync` runs `+force_install_dir … +login anonymous +workshop_download_item 108600 +quit` headless, serialized through a static `SemaphoreSlim(1)` because SteamCMD can't handle concurrent instances. Output lines stream back via `OutputDataReceived` → dispatcher → log panel + the download row's Detail. - After SteamCMD finishes, it inspects the cache at `steamapps\workshop\content\108600\\`. The normal case copies each folder under its `mods\` subdir into `dest\ ` (display name read from `mod.info`'s `name=`, sanitized for the filesystem). A collection item containing multiple mod folders installs multiple destinations; a malformed item with no `mods` subdir is copied raw as `dest\`. Existing destination folders are deleted first so name drift (renamed/recased subfolders) doesn't leave duplicate copies. - Also hosts the `mod.info` parsing helpers: `GetModDisplayName`, `GetRequiresFields` (splits `require=` on commas/semicolons, strips backslash prefixes), and `GetModIdentifiers` (`id=`/`name=` values — used only to resolve `require=` references, never to identify a mod). **`WorkshopApiService.cs`** — Steam's public, key-less `GetPublishedFileDetails` endpoint for one item. Returns title, sizes, dates, `hcontent_file` (used as the real "version"), and the author's SteamID64. Handles Steam's quirk of returning numeric JSON fields as strings. (Intentionally unmodified per the user's constraint.) **`WorkshopVisualService.cs`** — same endpoint, batched up to **100 ids per request**, to fetch `preview_url` + tags for thumbnails and the tag sidebar. **`WorkshopPageService.cs`** — fetches a mod's Workshop **HTML page** and regex-scrapes the "Required items" section (`
Title
`). This is the only place a name-only `require=\NeatUI_Framework` entry can be mapped to a real numeric workshop id. Uses a browser UA header; best-effort parsing (Steam markup shifts). **`ThumbnailStore.cs`** — local cache of thumbnails as `.jpg` under `…\thumbnails\`, reused across runs; only genuinely missing images are re-downloaded. Never throws. **`SettingsService` / `DownloadHistoryStore` / `UninstalledModsStore`** — plain JSON persistence (`settings.json`, `download_history.json`, `uninstalled_mods.json`), each tolerant of corrupt/missing files (fall back to defaults/empty). `AppSettings` also stores per-mod `LocalModVersions` (manifest id) and `InstallDates` dictionaries. --- ### Notable functionality in the code **Update detection (`RefreshDownloadedModsAsync`, MainWindow.xaml.cs:621)** — One pass does both listing and update-checking. For each subfolder it extracts the workshop id (`TryExtractWorkshopId`: numeric folder-name prefix, or a purely numeric `id=` line inside a `mod.info`; `_`-prefixed folders like `_backups` are skipped), queries Steam for live metadata, and compares the recorded local `hcontent_file` against the live one. Mods never tracked before (manually placed) are flagged for the user to decide; mods unreachable from Steam are *not* false-flagged. Results feed a count + enables "Update All". **Dependency resolution — purely local, zero extra API calls** — During refresh it builds an identifier→workshopId index from installed mods' `id=`/`name=` (normalized by stripping case/punctuation via `NormalizeModIdentifier`) and checks each `require=` against it: numeric entries against the installed-id set, names against the index. **"Show Deps" dialog (MainWindow.xaml.cs:1115)** — Triggered only on explicit user action, fetches only that mod's page, cached per session with an in-flight guard against duplicate clicks. The Workshop page is authoritative (lists all deps, installed or not); a fallback resolves `mod.info` `require=` locally when the page has no "Required items" section. `DepsDialog` lists each dependency with an installed/missing annotation; missing numeric deps can be queued directly, name-only ones open a Steam search in the embedded browser. "Add All" is disabled if the page fetch failed (list may be incomplete). **Uninstall/reinstall lifecycle** — Uninstall deletes the folder (after confirmation), logs to `uninstalled_mods.json`, and refreshes. Reinstall downloads a fresh copy and removes the entry; Forget just drops the record. **Backup-before-update** — Optional; copies the mod folder to `_backups\\\` before any update/redownload. Updates also `RemoveOldModFolder` first to avoid stale duplicate folders. **Export/Import mod lists** — Exports `Name/WorkshopID/Author/Link` XML; import adds ids to the queue, skipping already-installed/queued ones. **Batch-4 visual subsystem** — Thumbnails and tags load asynchronously after each refresh (`LoadInstalledVisualsAsync`, plus counterparts for history/uninstalled); thumbnail downloads are throttled to 4 concurrent via a `SemaphoreSlim`. `ModRecord`/`DownloadTask`/`UninstalledModEntry` implement `INotifyPropertyChanged` on `ThumbnailPath` so grids/tiles update in place. Tiles show a letter placeholder (`Initial`) until the image arrives, sized by the app-wide `ModTileSize` resource shared by all three tabs' tile views. **Tag filter sidebar** — Rebuilt from the union of Steam tags across installed mods, preserving checked selections. Applies a `CollectionViewSource` filter on the shared collection so the grid and tile view filter together; mods with no tag data stay visible so nothing hides by accident. **Status pulse animations** — The update-status and requirements columns (and their tile equivalents) turn orange and pulse via `DataTrigger` + `BeginStoryboard` + `DoubleAnimation` on **Opacity**. The XAML comment explicitly warns not to animate brush `Color` because WPF freezes brushes in shared DataTemplates. **Log panel (`AppendLog`)** — Dispatcher-safe, timestamped, caps at 500 entries, color-coded by level (DEBUG/WARNING/ERROR). Auto-scrolls only when already at the bottom, otherwise shows a "Jump to Bottom" button. DEBUG lines are skipped unless debug logging is enabled.
